method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (duties-core.l4, with six regulative rules for the duties of the transferee and the commissioner) and a seat layer (duties-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a date outside 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027, commercial use, the other kinds of dutiable transaction, a transfer only partly under a will, and the schemes not deposited each answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Duties Act 1999 (A1999-7), Republication No 79 effective 16 December 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1999-7.txt; with the Taxation Administration (Amounts Payable—Duty) Determination 2026 (DI2026-155), the Home Buyer Concession Scheme Determination 2026 (DI2026-157) and the Pensioner Duty Concession Scheme Determination 2026 (DI2026-159), each as notified 30 June 2026 and commencing 1 July 2026, which set every rate and threshold (Tables 1-3 encoded as tables); and the Taxation Administration Act 1999 (A1999-4), Republication No 52 effective 26 November 2025, incorporated by Duties Act s 3. The TAA s 26 market rate component and the penalty unit value are not deposited: inputs.

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run duties-core.l4 ; l4 run duties-seat.l4 ; l4 run duties-cases-transferee.l4
checks.result: 186 assertions satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 5 #TRACEs with an expect line (4 breaches by the transferee, 1 obligation of the commissioner pending), each read and as expected
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the transferee buying a home or vacant land in the ACT, for a transaction dated 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027: Duties Act ss 7, 10 (kind of transaction and property), s 11 (the transaction date), ss 12, 13, s 15(1)-(2) (lodging within 90 days, regulative), s 16 and table 16 items 1, 3, 5 (payable on registration, 14 days, regulative), ss 18, 20(1), 21(1), 22(1), 31, s 232D(1)(a), ss 232E-232I; DI2026-155 pt 2 ss 4-5, Tables 1 and 2, pt 3 Table 3 (computed; the seat answers not covered for commercial use), Schedule 1 (eligible owner occupier transaction, the s 1(2) notice and s 1(3) fall-back, s 3(2)-(3) requests, s 5 application); DI2026-157 ss 4-8 and Schedules 1-2 (home buyer concession, nil); DI2026-159 ss 3-9 (pensioner duty concession, nil); TAA ss 25-27 (interest), ss 30-35 and table 34 (penalty tax), s 36, s 67, ss 100-104 (objection), as the HENCE and LEST branches. Out, each answering not covered: motor vehicle duty (ch 9), landholder and other ch 3 transactions, trusts, commercial leases with premium, s 33 business assets, commercial use, s 232D(2)-(3), pt 2.6A deferral, the Disability Duty Concession and Pensioner Duty Deferral schemes, s 109, foreign-purchaser matters, dates outside 2026-27. Read with subjects/au/social-security-act-1991, veterans-entitlements-act-1986, family-law-act-1975 and income-tax-assessment-act-1997 (s 110-35(4)); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seat: the transferee: an individual buying a home or vacant land in the ACT, as a first-time buyer, an owner-occupier, a pensioner downsizing, or an investor (Table 2)
